jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 전유공용면적 lane `building-register-unit-areas` (root ADR-0169 ②): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_register_unit_areas already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed keys' rows and a removal marker per vanished key (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

open_exception.why: Its one long run, 2026-10-20T13:02Z, took 8,573 s of the 9,000 s limit (95%); a refresh of more changed keys would not fit.
open_exception.tracked_by: root ADR-0391 addendum (2026-11-04): the lane loads its release part by part, 20 parts a step under run_budget.step_seconds_max 2,805 s, and resumes after its deadline; dropped once the first part release (the November hub release) is measured. Root ADR-0386 §5 for the per-run vocabulary
